name: J-PARC accelerator complex, Tokai
notes: No official J-PARC page read on 2026-09-16 published latitude/longitude; the coordinates are the OpenStreetMap/Nominatim point for the J-PARC industrial landuse polygon, cross-checked against the official postal address. They are a site-scale marker, not a survey point.

summary.plain: The J-PARC laboratory site on the Pacific coast at Tokai, about 115 km north-east of Tokyo, where the proton accelerators and the neutrino beam target are.
summary.technical: Surface site at Tokai-mura, Naka-gun, Ibaraki, holding the linac, the 3 GeV RCS, the 30 GeV main ring and the neutrino experimental facility (target station, decay volume, beam dump).
